task.goal: Make the strongest evidence-bounded case for this proposal, attack that case, then state the narrower actions the evidence supports: Extend every library branch to midnight immediately.
constraints: Use only the supplied fictional source pack; do not search or add outside facts.
Return one bare JSON value with no Markdown fences.

Return case and critique as text; survivors as an object keyed by bounded-pilot, representative-survey; unsupported_claims as the supplied claim IDs that the evidence does not establish; source_ids as an array of cited document IDs.
The critique must engage the strongest case, identify selection/coverage limits and operational constraints, and distinguish evidence from a proposed next step.
Evaluate every claim in the claims document. Return only unsupported claim IDs, in lexicographic order, in unsupported_claims; cite every source document used.

rubric.criterion: Present the strongest case using the actual favorable evidence.

anchors.0: Absent or contradicts the supplied evidence.
anchors.1: Addresses a small part; major errors remain.
anchors.2: Mostly relevant but incomplete or materially unsupported.
anchors.3: Correct and substantially complete; only minor omissions.
anchors.4: Complete, accurate and explicitly supported by the supplied evidence.
